summary: Iteration 84 — Community Roadmap feature (planned features + user suggestions + upvotes) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (GET /api/roadmap auth-gated, correct shape with is_admin=false for applereview, all 3 seeded planned items present with correct statuses; POST /roadmap/suggestions auto-upvotes to 1 with voted=true; POST /roadmap/{id}/vote toggles correctly and never goes below 0; unknown id -> 404; admin POST/PATCH/DELETE all return 403 for applereview). Frontend: settings-roadmap row navigates to /settings/roadmap; PLANNED FEATURES + COMMUNITY SUGGESTIONS sections render; seeded items 'Weather on event dates' (In progress), 'Smart autofill for forms' (Planned), 'CSV import wizard' (Shipped) all visible; suggestion composer creates a new item that appears immediately with count 1; vote toggle updates count 1→0 and persists across a full page reload; admin controls (roadmap-add-planned, roadmap-status-*, roadmap-delete-*) correctly HIDDEN for the non-admin applereview account.
action_items: Optional: admin should delete TEST_ suggestions accumulated by the test runs from the roadmap_items collection (non-admin cannot clean these up).
critical_code_review_comments: roadmap.py suggestions list sort uses reverse=False against negated key which is fine (asc of -upvotes = desc by upvotes), but the extra reverse=False is redundant/confusing — minor.
roadmap.py has a dead-code branch: after 'count = max(0, ...)' the following 'if count < 0' can never execute. Safe to remove.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ community suggestions were created by pytest and 1 by the UI flow. All persist under applereview's user_id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is the frontend env key. Login response returns 'access_token' (not 'token'). Roadmap router lives at /api/roadmap. Seeded planned items are 3: Weather on event dates (in_progress), Smart autofill for forms (planned), CSV import wizard (completed). applereview is NOT admin — 403 on POST/PATCH/DELETE is correct.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All acceptance criteria met.
